crossRefs.note: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?
After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,
He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,
The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.
He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water…

translations.web: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”
translations.bsb: He feels only the pain of his own body and mourns only for himself.”
translations.kjv: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.
translations.asv: But his flesh upon him hath pain, And his soul within him mourneth.
